metadata.purpose: Wire 37 unused CT.gov columns into 34 new features for Gungnir v35
metadata.note: All features are T-1 compliant (knowable before readout event)

ep_is_os.description: Overall Survival endpoint — gold standard for oncology
ep_is_os.note: All values are T-1 compliant (knowable before readout)

ep_is_pfs.description: Progression-Free Survival endpoint — intermediate, faster signal
ep_is_pfs.note: All values are T-1 compliant (knowable before readout)

ep_is_orr.description: Objective Response Rate endpoint — binary response measure
ep_is_orr.note: All values are T-1 compliant (knowable before readout)

ep_is_safety.description: Safety endpoint — typically unblinded, lower threshold
ep_is_safety.note: All values are T-1 compliant (knowable before readout)

ep_is_biomarker.description: Biomarker endpoint — mechanistic, not directly clinical
ep_is_biomarker.note: All values are T-1 compliant (knowable before readout)

ep_is_pk_pd.description: PK/PD endpoint — pharmacokinetic/dynamic, early stage proof
ep_is_pk_pd.note: All values are T-1 compliant (knowable before readout)

ep_is_qol.description: Quality of Life endpoint — subjective, soft endpoint, placebo sensitive
ep_is_qol.note: All values are T-1 compliant (knowable before readout)

num_primary_outcomes.description: Number of primary outcomes — trial complexity/focus
num_primary_outcomes.note: All values are T-1 compliant (knowable before readout)

num_secondary_outcomes.description: Number of secondary outcomes — exploratory depth
num_secondary_outcomes.note: All values are T-1 compliant (knowable before readout)

num_total_outcomes.note: All values are T-1 compliant (knowable before readout)

primary_timeframe_days.description: Days from baseline to primary endpoint measurement — durability signal
primary_timeframe_days.note: All values are T-1 compliant (knowable before readout)

time_start_to_primary_completion.description: Total planned trial duration for primary endpoint
time_start_to_primary_completion.note: All values are T-1 compliant (knowable before readout)

time_to_readout_days.description: Calendar days from study start to readout event
time_to_readout_days.note: All values are T-1 compliant (knowable before readout)

inclusion_criteria_count.description: Number of inclusion criteria — population specificity
inclusion_criteria_count.note: All values are T-1 compliant (knowable before readout)

exclusion_criteria_count.description: Number of exclusion criteria (note: mostly 0 in dataset)
exclusion_criteria_count.note: All values are T-1 compliant (knowable before readout)

total_criteria_count.note: All values are T-1 compliant (knowable before readout)

elig_text_length.description: Character length of eligibility criteria text
elig_text_length.note: All values are T-1 compliant (knowable before readout)

has_drug.note: All values are T-1 compliant (knowable before readout)

has_biological.note: All values are T-1 compliant (knowable before readout)

has_genetic.description: Intervention has genetic component (gene therapy, etc)
has_genetic.note: All values are T-1 compliant (knowable before readout)

has_combination.note: All values are T-1 compliant (knowable before readout)

has_active_comparator.note: All values are T-1 compliant (knowable before readout)

has_sham_comparator.description: Has sham/device control — less common, surgical trials
has_sham_comparator.note: All values are T-1 compliant (knowable before readout)

is_industry.description: Sponsored by pharma/biotech industry (higher regulatory standards)
